standards.mechanism: Gate job reading every needed job's result, run with if: always() (a skipped job reports success to a required check)
always() runs even when the run is cancelled; default success()
needs context, needs.<job_id>.result values (success, failure, cancelled, skipped), toJSON
Expression values into a run: script only through env
Local composite action (runs.using: composite, shell required on run, a script beside action.yml through GITHUB_ACTION_PATH, called with uses: ./path after checkout)
curl --max-time, --retry with its built-in backoff, --retry-all-errors (partial output removed before a retry)
yq v4 and jq preinstalled on ubuntu-24.04 (checked locally with yq 4.54.1, the runner's version)
Download pinned by version and SHA-256, sha256sum --check --strict (unchanged pins, moved)

supervisor_checks: AC7: push story/9.1 with scripts/push-and-watch.sh, then gh pr create --base main --head story/9.1 --title '<conventional title>' --body '<summary>'; wait for both events; gh pr checks <n> lists ci-passed and security-passed as pass (GitHub Actions app), every check of the push and pull_request runs passing; only then scripts/merge-story.sh. After the fast-forward: gh pr view <n> --json state (MERGED), else gh pr close <n>.
After the fast-forward: main's CI run succeeds with publish (proof of publish's install-trivy call after its checkout).

Throwaway branch from story/9.1 with a pull request to main, never merged, one change at a time, each must fail as named: (1) exit 1 step in vulnerable-packages, so security-passed shows 'vulnerable-packages: failure'; (2) exit 1 step with if: matrix.language == 'csharp' in codeql, so security-passed shows 'codeql: failure' (the undocumented combined result); (3) if: false on e2e, so floor-guard fails (ci-gates.sh: e2e has a job-level if:) and ci-passed shows 'e2e: skipped' (floor-guard: failure too); (4) gh run cancel <id> while e2e runs, so ci-passed still runs and shows each cancelled job; (5) one character of sha256 in .github/actions/install-compose/install.sh, so backend, platform and e2e fail at the checksum and ci-passed names all three; (6) one character of sha256 in .github/actions/install-trivy/install.sh, so trivy fails and security-passed shows 'trivy: failure'; (7) a failing assertion in one backend test, so ci-passed shows 'backend: failure'; (8) a dummy job in ci.yml left out of ci-passed's needs, so floor-guard fails naming it.

Against today's files: scripts/ci-gates.sh on the base commit's ci.yml and security.yml already fails, naming the five conditional jobs (TestResults/9.1-ci-gates-before.txt); the supervisor can repeat it with git show 7764c9e:.github/workflows/ci.yml > /tmp/ci.yml && scripts/ci-gates.sh /tmp/ci.yml ci-passed publish
assumptions: Criterion 8's floor-guard step calls a new script, scripts/ci-gates.sh, with a test, scripts/ci-gates.test.sh, rather than inline yq in the step, so the check is test-first and shellcheck-linted; the script also fails a check job with a job-level if: or needs:, which enforces criterion 1's structure in CI. Neither file is in the story's Touches list.

ci-gates.test.sh also asserts each gate's settings, publish's if and needs, and that each local install action runs after its job's checkout in exactly the expected jobs. actionlint 1.7.12 does not report a uses: ./ path to a missing local action (checked in a scratch copy), and publish runs only on main, so this test is the pre-merge guard for criterion 5's 'after their checkout'.
The gate's run: script with a NEEDS that is not JSON exits with jq's code 5 (the step's -e stops it), so it fails closed; the test asserts non-zero, not exactly 1.
With if: false on e2e (Supervisor check 3), floor-guard also fails, because ci-gates.sh rejects a job-level if:, so ci-passed names 'e2e: skipped' and 'floor-guard: failure'.

Local tools for the checks: actionlint 1.7.12 and yq 4.54.1 darwin_arm64 and Trivy 0.76.1 macOS-ARM64, each checked against its release's checksums file, in /tmp/dd91tools.g2wK (outside the repo). The breaks and ci-gates.test.sh need yq v4 and jq on PATH; break b5 needs Docker and the network.
The smoke container pulled the public ubuntu:24.04 image (a newer digest than the one on the shared daemon); it is not a disputedesk build, so it was left in place.
The two gates' run: scripts are the same five lines in two workflows; kept as plain duplication (two copies; AGENTS.md abstracts on the third).
